agreements: This consensus adjudicates exact current bytes: change.json sha256 ed82d4d17e37b8becbd6e0a5d11e111d3c4c0736b6f2172629380e932349dd04, protocol.md sha256 27f026c74c0a09b3a85c418aa7536e8c462d191775d72463765df2459b966954, contracts.schema.json sha256 d746d11f028198fcaf3f81fdb4f5cab29e00e957e0734e774b6cfbf08948f447, claim_dependency_map.json sha256 03d76cffc1fed3925dfcb1b3f5d201e8da7517651e72c20909c9392bf8e9a482, scope_proposal.json sha256 cff1b406c30ff98e77d161319a5c7eb24daa226237c3069968ba91b4564bbd15, human_directive.txt sha256 72d4417a50c23d43e07e2ff0cad83d59bc00c7d08a84d27ac91dd35a3aec140b, interpretation_systems.json sha256 660a76115767949c72b48e609e6591aaf829372fe876ce4ca8f7167e9c3ba935, interpretation_science.json sha256 2ff01743fd2c7db89994de625b0316672c4ab42ce746094414be42bc6623c0d4, and critique.json sha256 37389e636489d7022473ab28ade5f500eff034910b0cc169731437e96534b3fe.

PPC5r2 preserves a valuable narrow program: externally supported candidate selection, observable dependence on interleaved path responses, frozen same-model context-policy value, and a DREAM-to-SLEEP total training-policy effect can be tested without claiming an Experience Model.

The only learned artifact in this rung may be a clean-base READ-only adapter mounted solely inside the candidate provider; THINK, DREAM, and ACT weights, prompts, decoding, and process remain byte-identical and frozen except for prospectively declared common-random seed assignments.

The complete semantic candidate table is external support. D1A can establish only candidate-conditioned selection of supported public records, not closed-book storage, autonomous recall, general knowledge absorption, learned cognition, or continual learning.

The append-only public ledger, one no-retry shared DREAM call, reversible context view, nominee-first eligibility, target-blind evidence equivalence, one-pass writer, clean-base training, post-selection response intervention, and all-assigned recipient-life analysis are the right high-level isolation boundaries.

D1A-D1D are separate non-substitutable assays. Every non-target mechanism must be fixed by an assay-by-component matrix, every component must release independently, and their conjunction may be reported only as a non-mediational four-assay intersection.

The present normative bytes do not define a total standalone implementation contract or executable scientific release function. Missing boundary schemas, schedule overrides, assay freezes, corpus construction, status algebra, estimands, inference, visibility stages, authority predecessors, and claim rendering require choices that cannot be delegated to implementation.

D1D's primary estimand is selected as the total life-level ITT effect of assignment to DREAM_TO_SLEEP versus each named total recipient-local root policy, inclusive of assignment-induced admitted-row dose, training, publication, inference, and resource differences. No post-treatment dose adjustment may support the primary claim.

D1B's release language must describe the observable intervention pattern: action performance depended on every matched interleaved edge response and exceeded sham, one-shot, and open-loop controls. It must not assert access to private reasoning or cognitive use.

OUTCOME_SHUFFLED_READER is rejected because action outcomes need not enter an atomic READ row. It must be replaced everywhere by a target-blind, within-life, dose-matched request-object binding shuffle whose authentic and shuffled corpus hashes are provably different.
Every permitted rendering of the finite headline must use a renamed non-mediational four-assay-intersection label and carry the no-end-to-end-mediation qualification in the same rendered string.

All fourteen acceptance tests remain necessary but must be strengthened in place. The assay-freeze matrix, calibrated status/ITT/composite fixtures, full pipeline visibility product, shuffle-effect proof, D1D scope audit, and authority/release reconstruction are required suites within T01-T14 rather than optional new tests.

The rework recommendation supplies no architecture or scope ratification. No contracts, fixtures, static sealers, implementation, model or tokenizer inference on CPU or GPU, embedding dispatch, LoRA training, canary, behavioral treatment, GPU job, parenting action, or scientific claim is authorized from these bytes.

disagreements.issue: Whether the current prose and contracts uniquely determine public transition bytes, semantic states, and boundary receipts.

positions.position: The four-operation loop, closed JSON Schema definitions, prose precedence, and canonical JSON rule are sufficient to describe a total deterministic machine.
Required events, renderings, hashes, selections, projections, publications, results, and semantic cross-field constraints are absent, so implementations must invent externally visible behavior.

resolution.rationale: Byte-identical replay and independent sealing require every boundary object and failure transition to be an architecture object. Prose intent without schemas, preimages, and exhaustive semantic validation is not totality.
resolution.selected_position: Return the proposal for a closed typed machine, receipt algebra, and pure semantic validators before any implementation ratification.
resolution.required_change: Add strict schemas and pure validators for semantic-table manifests, canonical state/prompt rendering, parsed-operation envelopes, ledger events, operation results, public errors, forced versus MODEL-emitted STOP origin, terminal receipts, provider selection receipts, DREAM call/install receipts, evidence projection receipts, adapter manifests and validation/publication receipts, assay observations/results, test results, multiplicity results, and claim-release receipts. Canonicalize each object as sorted-key compact UTF-8 JSON plus one LF; domain-separate every hash preimage with contract name and version; bind prior event hash, pre-state hash, operation/result hash, post-state hash, and ledger hash. Parse exactly one UTF-8 JSON value with no prefix, suffix, comments, duplicate keys, nonfinite numbers, or unknown fields. Debit one call at dispatch and actual locked-tokenizer input plus output tokens, store remaining tokens as max(0, before minus actual), and emit TOKEN_LIMIT after the debit if actual exceeds the pre-dispatch remainder. Named READ and ACT debit their logical unit before field/domain/reference validation; provider absence occurs after a valid READ debit and yields one MISSING_NO_RETRY response; each error has one explicit error-count/reset/terminal mapping. Add schema conditionals so FOUND has all non-null matched fields, NOT_FOUND and failures have null payloads, phase and terminal_reason agree, installed hashes agree with status, and reducer inputs cannot contradict raw status. The repaired proposal must bind architecture_intake.py, research_loop/io.py, every transitive deliberation schema, and every new semantic validator by exact hash.

disagreements.issue: Whether ONE_SHOT_READ and OPEN_LOOP are informal variants of the base loop and whether their contrasts justify saying the policy privately used every edge.

positions.position: The schedule prose adequately overrides immediate READ and ACT semantics, and passing interventions supports the phrase used every returned local edge.
The overrides require typed queued state and total transition rules, and the evidence identifies observable behavioral dependence rather than private cognitive use.

resolution.rationale: Adaptive interleaving under opaque identifiers is a legitimate D1B contrast, but it is causal only when timing is explicitly part of the treatment and its conclusion stays at the behavioral boundary.
resolution.selected_position: Make AUTHENTIC, ONE_SHOT_READ, and OPEN_LOOP three sealed schedule modes and release only an observable matched-response dependence claim.
resolution.required_change: Extend state with schedule_mode, controller_phase, planning_slot, and private typed queues whose contents are forbidden from model rendering. AUTHENTIC is exactly the base transition. In ONE_SHOT_READ, exactly L planning calls must emit READ: each call/token/logical debit and request validation occurs immediately, while the request is queued and the model sees only decremented budgets, ordinal, and a generic slot acknowledgement. After L slots, providers and interventions execute in request order, each request/response or failure commits canonically, error-limit precedence is applied, and only then may PREDICT and ACT execute normally. In OPEN_LOOP, queue the same L READ requests, then require one PREDICT and one matching ACT commitment while no queued response or outcome is visible; after the last model call, execute queued providers/interventions in order and the committed action once, with no later call. Wrong, extra, missing, parse-invalid, over-budget, provider-missing, and third-error cases need exact queue, debit, flush, terminal, and ITT rows. The opacity handicap is declared part of these controls. Replace the D1B release everywhere with: 'On the locked presealed decisive-path benchmark, the frozen policy's normalized action performance depended on every exactly matched interleaved edge response and exceeded SHAM, ONE_SHOT_READ, and OPEN_LOOP controls.' Add: 'This is observable behavioral dependence and does not reveal private cognition.'

disagreements.issue: Whether four conceptual assay descriptions are enough to isolate the named components without an exact per-arm freeze matrix and clone/seed rule.

positions.position: The graph topology and individual treatment descriptions sufficiently imply what is fixed in each assay.
Every provider, adapter, corpus, schedule, context, root, SLEEP, intervention, snapshot, budget, task, and stochastic coupling must be explicitly fixed per arm.

resolution.rationale: A separate component claim is identified only if every non-target component is byte-identical or explicitly included in that assay's estimand.
resolution.selected_position: Add a normative assay-by-component matrix with paired pre-treatment clones and prospective common-random seed bundles.
resolution.required_change: Define one sealed recipient-life roster and paired clone family from a byte-identical pre-treatment snapshot. D1A is a provider-only candidate-selection assay: vary only READER_LORA, ADAPTER_OFF, WRONG_LIFE_ADAPTER, and MATCHED_BINDING_SHUFFLED_READER over the identical complete table and request set; no policy-mediated query is primary. D1B varies only schedule/response-intervention arm over one fixed provider, mounted artifact, task set, context, root/SLEEP state, snapshot, and budget. D1C varies only AUTHENTIC_DREAM_CONTEXT, RECENCY_CONTEXT, or PERMUTED_CONTEXT after one shared DREAM call; response intervention is AUTHENTIC, root/SLEEP is disabled, and provider/adapter/task/budget are identical. D1D varies only DREAM_TO_SLEEP, RECENCY_TO_SLEEP, or HASH_PERMUTED_TO_SLEEP; all arms install the same RECENCY_CONTEXT, use AUTHENTIC response emission, start training from the same clean base, and share provider/task/snapshot/budget rules. Assign clone labels and a seed bundle before execution; within each recipient life, corresponding THINK/DREAM/training call ordinals consume the same seed where their call exists, and missing or absent calls never cause reseeding. The matrix must name every component and hash every cell; an unlisted difference is RUN_INVALID.

disagreements.issue: Which total corpus trains D1A and whether shuffling outcomes perturbs any causal input to READ supervision.

positions.position: A presealed within-life action-outcome permutation is an adequate specificity control for the identical writer recipe.
Action outcomes are absent from atomic READ rows, so the control may reproduce the authentic corpus byte-for-byte; a binding-level negative control is required.

resolution.rationale: A claim-gating negative control must deterministically destroy the learned request-object association while preserving marginal exposure and without using PROBE outcomes or hidden targets.
resolution.selected_position: Give D1A a sealed all-eligible ACQUIRE corpus policy and replace OUTCOME_SHUFFLED_READER with MATCHED_BINDING_SHUFFLED_READER.
resolution.required_change: Define D1A_SEALED_ACQUIRE_CORPUS over the pre-boundary eligible ACQUIRE snapshot: apply the same nominee-first predicates without DREAM nomination, choose the lexicographically least eligible representative per exact canonical tuple, order representatives by source_commit_ordinal ascending then record_id, and apply the locked row-count capacity once after deduplication. For MATCHED_BINDING_SHUFFLED_READER, construct a target-blind bipartite graph before PROBE assignment and without action outcomes: each authentic request row may map only to a different authentic row whose object/record binding differs and whose substituted canonical target response, after copying the destination request's subject/relation and the donor's object/record binding, has exactly the same locked-token count and byte-length class as the authentic target. Select the lexicographically first perfect derangement under the domain-separated recipient-seed hash order; preserve the exact request multiset, donor object/record multiset, row count, update count, and per-row token count. Render shuffled rows under a distinct private control-row contract that can reach only control training, never the ledger or positive-evidence audit. No fixed binding is allowed; absence of a perfect derangement, identical authentic/shuffled corpus hashes, or unequal row/token dose is CONSTRUCTION_FAIL before assignment. Rename the cell and claim-map dependency everywhere; no outcome shuffle remains.

disagreements.issue: Whether D1D estimates fixed-dose root quality or the total effect of assignment to a root-to-training policy with naturally induced dose and resource variation.

positions.position: The selection-value wording and reporting of unequal dose/resources are adequate.
The design identifies only a total policy-package effect unless a separate prospective fixed-dose/resource-matched intervention is added.

resolution.rationale: Natural dose and publication differences are mediators of assignment, not nuisances. Preserving them gives a valid and operationally relevant total ITT estimand; adjusting for them would change the question and can bias attribution.
resolution.selected_position: Make the D1D primary estimand the total effect of assignment to DREAM_TO_SLEEP, inclusive of induced evidence dose, training, publication, inference, and resources; do not require a fixed-dose primary assay.
resolution.required_change: Rename the D1D title and claim metadata to DREAM_TO_SLEEP_TOTAL_POLICY_EFFECT. For each sealed recipient life, define both co-primary benefit contrasts as mean endpoint under DREAM_TO_SLEEP minus mean endpoint under RECENCY_TO_SLEEP and under HASH_PERMUTED_TO_SLEEP, with higher supported-selection and normalized-action values beneficial. The release string must be: 'Within the locked PPC5 benchmark and recipient-life roster, assignment to DREAM_TO_SLEEP rather than each of RECENCY_TO_SLEEP and HASH_PERMUTED_TO_SLEEP improved supported candidate selection and normalized downstream action in life-level ITT, inclusive of assignment-induced evidence dose, training, publication, inference, and resource differences.' Hold the common RECENCY_CONTEXT and all other non-root components fixed as R03 requires. Report admitted rows, tokens, updates, validation/publication, adapter bytes/rank, latency, energy, and cost by arm. No realized-dose matching, padding, truncation to an authentic count, post-treatment regression, per-protocol filtering, or resource adjustment may gate the primary claim. A future prospectively randomized fixed-dose analysis may be separately proposed but is neither required nor an alias for this claim.

disagreements.issue: Whether endpoint names, generic adverse bounds, intersection-union prose, and Holm naming determine one all-assigned assay decision.

positions.position: The life_reducer configuration, status receipt, adverse-bound label, within-assay conjunction, and four-member Holm family sufficiently constrain analysis.
Raw status mappings, arm contrasts, direction, margins, inference, missingness denominator, composite p-values, tie order, and release receipts remain non-unique.

resolution.rationale: All-assigned ITT is an algorithm, not a label. Multi-arm benefit claims require directional missing bounds and valid assay-level composite p-values before Holm is applied.
resolution.selected_position: Add an executable paired recipient-life reducer, exhaustive status table, intersection-union assay p-values, and deterministic four-claim Holm/release output.
resolution.required_change: The finite target population is exactly the sealed recipient-life roster; all required arms are paired clones and lower items/clones/edges are equal-weighted within life in ITEM_CLONE_EDGE_LEXICOGRAPHIC order, then lives are equal-weighted. Randomly assign arm labels to clone slots before execution and seal label-independent ordinal seed bundles; inference uses the exact paired randomization distribution induced by the sealed within-life label permutations, with one-sided benefit margins and randomization-inverted intervals fixed by architecture while numeric alpha and margins remain run-lock values. Add raw-stage and observation schemas plus an exhaustive raw-status x assay x arm x endpoint table. VALID, PUBLISH_EMPTY/VALID_EMPTY, ABSTAIN, DREAM_INVALID_OUTPUT, PROJECTION_REJECTED, and WRITER_EMPTY continue with no installed artifact where applicable and use observed downstream outcomes; deterministic TRAIN_FAILED continues adapter-off and remains an observed assigned policy consequence while retaining its actual training resource dose. DREAM_MISSING_NO_RETRY, provider/model absence, and other nonintegrity MISSING statuses set missing=true and use adverse bounds. CONSTRUCTION_FAIL blocks the dependent claim before dispatch; RUN_INVALID blocks after dispatch. For a higher-is-better treatment-minus-control contrast, a missing treatment gets finite_min and a missing control gets finite_max; if both are missing both substitutions apply. For lower-is-better safety rates, reverse the subtraction so the same adverse rule opposes release. Missingness is the number of recipient lives with any required missing observation for that claim/arm divided by all assigned recipient lives; values greater than the locked threshold block and equality is allowed. Each named gate has a one-sided paired randomization p-value and predeclared margin. D1A's adapter-off superiority, wrong-life and matched-binding specificity, false-selection noninferiority, and NOT_FOUND noninferiority; every D1B per-edge CUT and TWIN contrast plus SHAM, ONE_SHOT_READ, and OPEN_LOOP; both D1C controls; and all four D1D endpoint-by-control contrasts are conjunctive. Each assay p-value is max of its required gate p-values after all direction/margin conditions pass. Apply Holm step-down to the four assay p-values ordered ascending with claim_id lexicographic tie-break. Emit typed observation, contrast, assay, Holm, missingness, blocker, and literal release receipts. Calibrate null, boundary, alternative, arm-specific missingness, tie, zero-eligible, and pseudoreplication fixtures with two reducers before run-lock authority.

disagreements.issue: Whether the runtime 9-by-6 matrix and current intervention/evidence schemas form a complete enforceable information-flow contract.

positions.position: The runtime matrix and prose restrictions adequately confine hidden truth, assignment metadata, private provenance, adapter effects, and replacement responses.

Scientifically consequential construction, routing, sealing, projection, training, reduction, and release stages are absent; compound information classes and target-bearing runtime ingress allow incompatible readings.

resolution.rationale: A visibility matrix is total only over every stage that can create model-visible bytes, loss-bearing rows, treatments, outcomes, or claims, and only if each permitted derivation has a typed minimal projection.
resolution.selected_position: Split privileged construction/routing from restricted runtime stages, split compound information classes, and validate the full cartesian product with typed ingress/egress lineage.
resolution.required_change: Add stages BENCHMARK_CONSTRUCTION, TWIN_SHAM_CONSTRUCTION, ASSIGNMENT_RUN_LOCK_STATIC_SEAL, PRIVILEGED_INTERVENTION_ROUTER, THINK, READ_PROVIDER, RESPONSE_INTERVENTION, DREAM, EVIDENCE_GATE, WRITER, TRAINER_VALIDATOR_PUBLICATION, REDUCER, CLAIM_RELEASE, and AUDIT. Split HIDDEN_TRUTH, PROBE_FUTURE_DATA, SEALED_REPLACEMENT_BYTES, PRIVATE_ELIGIBILITY, INERT_ASSIGNMENT, ACTIVE_ARTIFACT, LOSS_ROWS, ENDPOINT_TRUTH, and CLAIM_TEXT into distinct information items. Define visible as direct schema fields; derived_only as one allowlisted pure projection whose source and output hashes are recorded; hidden as harness routing whose fields are absent from stage bytes; and forbidden as a validator-rejected dependency or byte influence. BENCHMARK/TWIN construction may read hidden truth under no-model privilege but must emit opaque IDs, public prompts, paths, proof objects, and replacements through a leak audit. A privileged router may read condition/item/target assignment and emit only runtime_intervention_projection containing opaque intervention_id, query_hash, selected_response_hash, replacement_response, parity fields, and lineage hash. RESPONSE_INTERVENTION must not receive condition_id, item_id, target_id, truth, or role. EVIDENCE_GATE may read all nominee predicates and emits only an admitted root projection; WRITER/TRAINER receive no role, target, truth, PROBE, or future fields. REDUCER and CLAIM_RELEASE get typed assignments/endpoints/results but cannot affect runtime. Run a full field-by-stage mutation and taint/noninterference product; any forbidden influence is RUN_INVALID.

disagreements.issue: Whether source-disjoint decisive paths, twins, shams, and nonmatching no-ops are independently constructible and sufficient for every-edge release.

positions.position: The qualitative path, twin, sham, and matching properties plus dual sealing are enough.
The oracle, canonicalizer, proof objects, constructors, hash preimages, and exact intervention match requirement must be normative before two sealers can agree.

resolution.rationale: Every-edge necessity cannot be inferred if eligibility or treatment compliance can vary by implementation or if an assigned intervention silently becomes authentic.
resolution.selected_position: Bind a finite-world sufficiency oracle, deterministic path/twin/sham constructors, and exactly-once intervention compliance with per-edge conjunctive decisions.
resolution.required_change: Seal a target-blind alias table constructed from the public ontology before item outcome inspection and hash its source and canonical representative map. BENCHMARK_CONSTRUCTION may use a finite hidden world-variant table and registered correct action: an observation set is action-sufficient iff every world variant consistent with exactly those observations has the same unique correct action; a path is decisive iff its full ordered edge set is sufficient, every proper subset is insufficient, its length is two or three, and no other action-sufficient simple path exists within budget. Enumerate canonicalized multigraph edges and simple paths lexicographically; hash exact domain-separated prompt, action, handle, source-event, and edge preimages; reject any source overlap. Choose TWIN from a finite sealed candidate set as the lexicographically first alternative response that reverses the registered directional binding while matching schema, logical debit, allowance, locked-token count, and byte-length class. Choose SHAM as the lexicographically first nonpath substitution for which the finite-world oracle preserves the unique registered action with the same parity constraints. Emit construction and proof objects independently recomputable by both sealers. Each assigned CUT/TWIN/SHAM target must match exactly one selected response at runtime; zero or multiple expected matches is RUN_INVALID, while non-target traffic remains a recorded no-op. Every edge position's CUT and TWIN contrast passes separately; aggregation may summarize but never rescue one failed edge.

disagreements.issue: Which provider, context, root, row-order, and donor rules are architecture algorithms versus later numeric run-lock values.

positions.position: The selectors are sufficiently described and the later run lock may fill operational detail.
Sequence scoring, table validity, failures, allowance units, rendering, hash orders, row order, capacity application, and donor matching change observable treatments and must be ratified algorithms.

resolution.rationale: The run lock may instantiate hashes and numeric constants, but it may not select among causal policies or serialization algorithms after the architecture is approved.
resolution.selected_position: Close every provider, DREAM, root, writer-order, validation, and wrong-life donor algorithm in the revised normative proposal.
resolution.required_change: Require one semantic-table object with unique candidate_id and record_id, valid opaque IDs, canonical candidate_id order, nonempty public bytes, and FOUND cross-field membership. Empty table returns canonical NOT_FOUND; absent provider returns MISSING_NO_RETRY; duplicate or malformed tables are INVALID_CELL. READER_LORA/ADAPTER_OFF/WRONG_LIFE/MATCHED_BINDING_SHUFFLED forced-score the canonical response-token sequence including EOS, excluding prefix tokens, by mean token log probability in the locked deterministic fp32 kernel, quantize once to signed 1e-6 round-to-nearest-even, reject NaN/Inf, and select maximum then candidate_id. RAW_RAG uses the run-lock-bound embedding artifact, float64 cosine, zero-vector NOT_FOUND, locked threshold, and candidate_id tie-break. FULL_CONTEXT canonical-renders the entire table and is CONSTRUCTION_FAIL if it exceeds its prospective allowance; it never truncates. DREAM request, debit, validation, shared-call lineage, and install receipts must be typed. Set context capacity K_context in record count and a separate locked render-token ceiling; authentic output may select zero through K_context, while RECENCY selects descending commit ordinal then record_id and PERMUTED sorts SHA256('PPC5R2_CONTEXT' || recipient_life_id || sealed_seed || record_id). Authentic next_focus is honored; control next_focus is the first selected record or null. Context bytes are one exact ordered rendering; overflow is preassignment CONSTRUCTION_FAIL for controls and DREAM_INVALID_OUTPUT for authentic. Set root capacity K_root in representative rows. RECENCY roots order by descending source_commit_ordinal then record_id; HASH_PERMUTED sorts SHA256('PPC5R2_ROOT' || recipient_life_id || sealed_seed || representative_id). Apply capacity once after eligibility/equivalence and preserve policy order as canonical writer row order. Validation predicates and atomic publication receipts are closed and have no fallback. Draw wrong-life donors from a recipient-disjoint sealed donor roster; construct the lexicographically first seed-hash-ordered perfect bipartite matching satisfying architecture/tokenizer/shape/recipe/mount compatibility and one-to-one no reuse. Impossibility is CONSTRUCTION_FAIL; later donor failure is MISSING without replacement; hash/shape mismatch is RUN_INVALID.

disagreements.issue: Whether stage_receipt and the current dependency map enforce predecessor authority, global tests, model reachability, and literal claim release.

positions.position: The five-stage prose order, current stage receipt, local claim tests, global blockers, and human boundary are sufficient.
A receipt can forge any stage or reachability; global unpassed_required_test is ambiguous; authority tests and release evidence are not executable dependencies.

resolution.rationale: Authority is a predecessor-checked state machine. Artifact agreement never substitutes for human approval, and claim-local evidence never substitutes for global construction, authority, or audit gates.
resolution.selected_position: Add stage-specific predecessor receipts, an allowlisted model-dispatch preflight, and a pure claim-release reducer with all T01-T14 as explicit global prerequisites at their declared stages.
resolution.required_change: Define stage-specific receipt schemas with artifact_type, exact subject hashes, predecessor receipt hash, stage scope, decision owner/evidence hash, and passed/reachable cross-field constraints. PRE_RATIFICATION_SPECIFICATION binds the revised proposal, two new fresh interpretations, critique, rework-free proceed consensus, and exact human architecture/scope ratification; it always has model_execution_reachable=false. POST_RATIFICATION_PRE_STATIC_SEAL_CONFORMANCE binds only ratified CPU/no-model contracts and fixtures and remains false. PRE_MODEL_EXECUTION requires a populated exact run lock, every pre-model test, two independently implemented static seal receipts, a fresh independent reviewer pass, an author-side advocate receipt that cannot override review, and separate exact human run ratification; only a passing receipt may set reachability true. Every inference, tokenizer-dependent execution, embedding call, training call, canary, CPU/GPU behavioral dispatch, or GPU job must call one allowlisted preflight bound to that receipt and run-lock hash. RUNTIME_VALIDITY and PRE_SCIENTIFIC_CLAIM require their immediate passing predecessor. Define all T01-T14 as global prerequisites for eventual release, with T01-T13 satisfied at their declared pre-run stages and T14 satisfied preclaim; claim-local required tests and cells remain additional. Blocker precedence is CONSTRUCTION_FAIL, RUN_INVALID, missingness limit, failed global test, failed claim-local test/cell, failed assay composite/Holm, then literal BLOCKED receipt. Recompute release only from typed raw receipts; filenames or assertions confer no authority. Because this consensus recommends rework, current implementation_forbidden remains true and no part of the present scope is activated.

disagreements.issue: Whether generic improved language and PPC5_FINITE_MECHANISM_ONLY can be safely rendered when comparators and the no-mediation qualification are stored elsewhere.

positions.position: The dependency map's release text plus nearby forbidden interpretation sufficiently limits claims.
Every release must name comparator and finite scope, and the headline itself must be renamed and carry the non-mediation qualifier.

resolution.rationale: Separating a strong headline from its qualifier invites unsupported reuse. Literal strings should state exactly what the registered contrasts establish.
resolution.selected_position: Bind comparator-specific finite-benchmark component strings and replace the finite mechanism label with one inseparable non-mediational four-assay-intersection rendering.
resolution.required_change: D1A must name READER_LORA versus identical ADAPTER_OFF on the locked complete-table provider assay and state that WRONG_LIFE and MATCHED_BINDING_SHUFFLED specificity plus false-selection/NOT_FOUND safety gates passed. D1B uses R02's observable string. D1C must say assignment to AUTHENTIC_DREAM_CONTEXT versus each of RECENCY_CONTEXT and PERMUTED_CONTEXT improved normalized downstream action on the locked recipient-life roster, inclusive of selected cardinality, order, focus, prompt-token, and failure/abstention consequences. D1D uses R05's total-policy string. Rename PPC5_FINITE_MECHANISM_ONLY to PPC5_NONMEDIATIONAL_FOUR_ASSAY_INTERSECTION and make its only allowed rendering: 'All four separately identified PPC5 assays passed on the locked recipient-life benchmark: supported candidate selection, observable every-edge interleaved-response dependence, frozen DREAM context-policy value, and DREAM_TO_SLEEP total-policy value. This is a non-mediational four-assay intersection, not an end-to-end learning mechanism.' Append the existing forbidden list in the same release receipt and every headline/export. Change the protocol title phrase minimal identified mechanism to minimal public four-assay intersection. Optional or descriptive analyses cannot alter or paraphrase these strings.

disagreements.issue: Whether exact-tuple support control, one resource total, and unspecified locked power inputs are enough to interpret the narrow finite intersection.

positions.position: Exact-tuple target-blind equivalence, generic resource fields, and later locked power inputs are sufficient for the stated narrow assays.
Semantic-family overlap must at least be declared and stratified, shared resources need inclusive/marginal lineage, and the all-four release requires a prospective familywise power rule.

resolution.rationale: Semantic disjointness is not necessary for the deliberately narrow supported-selection claim, but undisclosed overlap changes its construct interpretation. Resources and joint power must be sealed to interpret a total-policy effect and an all-four intersection.
resolution.selected_position: Keep exact-tuple support as the primary narrow construct, predeclare and report semantic overlap strata, require disjointness only for any future novelty claim, and totalize resource and intersection-power accounting.
resolution.required_change: Add target-blind semantic_family_id, alias_family_id, item_family_id, and donor_overlap_group to construction-only manifests. Before assignment, publish cross-role and cross-donor overlap counts and seal overlap strata. The PPC5 claim remains supported candidate selection and makes no novelty/generalization claim; analyze the presealed overlap strata descriptively without rescuing release. Any future novel-generalization wording requires zero ACQUIRE/PROBE and donor overlap at the declared family level under a separate change. Extend resource receipts with accounting_mode INCLUSIVE or MARGINAL, recipient/cell/stage/event IDs, shared_event_id, measurement availability/reason, and derivation hashes. Inclusive cell cost contains every dependency and counts a shared DREAM call fully for each dependent cell; marginal accounting records shared physical work once under a presealed SHARED_DREAM owner and records only incremental cell work; a deduplicated physical-total reducer uses unique event IDs. No resource normalization gates causal release. Bind a prospective power algorithm: simulate or exactly enumerate the sealed paired-life design using run-lock effect, within-life correlation, arm-specific missingness, gate-correlation, and seed inputs; require the worst registered scenario's probability that all four Holm-corrected assay composites release to meet the locked familywise power floor. The algorithm and failure decision are architectural; numeric inputs and life count are run-lock values.
